title: console: Setup → Datasources shows a refusal's details.hint under its one-line message, so the remedy stays visible
body:
domain:server#2 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufziCTpjnYbdh76SAWwb

Filing gate: **④ coordination child**. This is the console reader of #32169 PR-1 (PR #32303), filed from that PR's contract review 6774354518 (finding 1, moved to a follow-up card). ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #32169

## 维护者速读

- 问题：#32303 落地后，数据源管理接口的拒绝只在 `message` 里给一行短句，原来的原因和补救办法移到了 `details.hint`。设置 → 数据源页面只弹 `error.message`，管理员会看不到怎么修。
- 原因：控制台读拒绝时只读 `message`，不读 `details`。
- 要做：页面在短句下方显示 `details.hint`（有就显示，没有就不显示）。按 `details.reason` 分支的地方，改为读 reason，不再匹配文字。
- 需要你做的：无。车道派发，等 #32169 关闭后开工。

## Measured (seat reading at `origin/main` `3191e007`, and PR #32303 head `4cf94756`)

- PR #32303 makes every `400 DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR` / `EXTERNAL_DATASOURCE_ERROR` refusal of `/api/v1/datasources/**` and `/api/v1/external-datasources/**` answer a one-line `message` (target ≤160 characters), plus `details.reason` (snake_case) and, when there is more to say, `details.hint` (the rationale and the remedy, one finding per line for list refusals). The connection test's `{ ok: false, error }` keeps line and hint in its one string, so the Test toast is unaffected.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/datasource/DatasourceResourcePage.tsx` raises `toast.error(error.message)` for these refusals (pinned by `DatasourceResourcePage.refusals-13207.test.tsx`, `.externalBlock-11368.test.tsx` and `.deleteConfirm-13333.test.tsx`). It reads no `details`.

## Wanted

- Wherever the page shows a datasource refusal (save, create, delete confirm, Sync-objects dialog, remote-tables), show `details.hint` under the line when it is present, keeping its line breaks. Show nothing extra when it is absent.
- Any branch that matches refusal text switches to `details.reason`.
- Pins: hint shown when present; absent → only the line (CONTROL); a multi-finding `invalid_config` hint keeps one finding per line.

## Not here

- Server shapes (PR #32303).
- Other doors' `userMessage` (#32278).
